title: Trio in Snowy Field, 1920s Sepia Snapshot, USA
back_text_transcription:
A 1

L. Rue & Lee Wilkerson
& mother Opal Marks
Floyd.
description: A vintage sepia snapshot depicting a young man standing affectionately between two women in a snow-covered rural yard or farm field. The man has his arms wrapped around the shoulders of both women, who are wearing patterned aprons over dark long dresses with boots. A rustic wooden gate and bare trees are visible in the background. Handwritten notes on the reverse identify the subjects as L. Rue, Lee Wilkerson, and mother Opal Marks Floyd.
